_comment: Labeled retrieval eval set. A chunk is relevant when it belongs to doc_id AND its raw text contains the evidence phrase (case/whitespace-insensitive). Phrase-based labels are chunking-strategy agnostic, so every strategy is graded against the same ground truth. evidence_v4 overrides the phrase after the v4.0 travel policy update.
